steps.goal: Find Tobin on the old cart road in Briarwood.
steps.text: Tobin, a carter from the capital, never came home last night. Kael takes the Guild's request and sets out along the old cart road through Briarwood to find him.
Deep in the woods, Kael finds Tobin beside his wrecked cart, cornered by a Field Hornet and a Slime.
Then a grey wolf steps out of the trees, its mana flowing the wrong way, like a river running uphill. Before Kael's eyes it changes into something far larger.

When it falls, the wolf dissolves into purple smoke and leaves behind a cold black crystal: the Tainted Shard. Kael brings a shaken Tobin home to the capital, where the gate guard has been waiting since dawn.

The Guild is packed. At its centre sits a face Kael never expected to see again: Professor Isolde Wyndmere, his old teacher from the Royal Magic Academy. She asks him to walk with her outside the walls tonight.

On Skyreach Hill, Kael shows Isolde the shard. With Mana Sight he follows the flow of mana to a crack in the ground, where the world's mana drains away and the same purple smoke seeps out. Isolde has been tracking these cracks for two years, each one closer to the capital than the last.
"Go. See the world. You'll find that we are small." Isolde sends Kael back to finish his exam first. Five months later, exactly one year after graduation, Kael earns his Mage Class 3 license.
The shard is still in his pocket. Kael tells the Guild he is stepping away from missions for a while. It is time to see the world.
License in hand, Kael is free at last. The world is waiting just outside the Guild's door.
Meanwhile, the Morning Gull docks at Saltwind Harbor. A swordswoman from Hōrai steps ashore, six weeks from home, looking for someone.

steps.goal: Buy 2 Honey Bread and 3 Sweet Buns at the Baker's Stall, then take them home to Mom on Ember Lane (Lantern Row).
steps.text: Before he goes anywhere, Kael has a promise to keep: Mom's shopping list. Two Honey Bread and three Sweet Buns from the Baker's Stall in the Market District, and not one coin on spellbooks. Then home with them, to the Ashveil house on Ember Lane, in the south of Lantern Row.
Mom gets her bread, and Kael promises to say goodbye properly before he leaves.

steps.goal: Buy the Silk Ribbon at the Tailor's stall for Selene.
steps.text: Then Selene comes running downstairs: a midnight-blue silk ribbon from the Tailor, please. Kael says no. Selene asks how a Class 3 mage plans to manage big missions if he can't manage a small one. Kael says yes.

Ribbon in hand, Kael hears a commotion by the shops. A swordswoman in strange clothes has knocked Tobin the carter to the ground, swearing he is a thief. Kael stands between them, and the stranger draws her sword.

The city guard breaks up the fight and throws them both in the same cell. The swordswoman is Yuki, from Hōrai. Sera, on an inspection, gets Kael out, and on his word has Yuki released too, on one condition: Yuki apologizes to the man she accused.
Outside the prison at night, Yuki insists she saw Tobin picking pockets. To settle it, Kael offers to take her to Tobin's house. With nowhere else to go, Yuki joins him.

steps.goal: Buy the Silk Ribbon at the Tailor's stall.
steps.text: Selene wants the midnight-blue silk ribbon from the Tailor's stall, and she paid the 120 Z herself. Not navy. Not sky blue. Midnight.

steps.goal: Bring the ribbon home to Selene.
steps.text: The ribbon is bought. Now it only has to make it home.
